name: Aluminium Fluoride (AlF3): Smelter Flux Import Substitution from Fertiliser Fluorine By-Product
scope: India's aluminium fluoride (AlF3) supply chain: the smelter build-out driving flux demand, the fertiliser FSA by-product route, and listed makers, entrants and smelter buyers.

summary.one_line: A quiet week for AlF3. Alufluoride's investor deck sizes demand from planned smelters at 21,600-30,900 tpa and shows customer concentration easing (largest customer 54% of FY26 AlF3 revenue, from 69%). NALCO incorporated its Angul power JV but filed nothing on the AlF3 EoI. Paradeep gave no AlF3 update, and its stock and Alufluoride's eased.
key_points: New this week: Alufluoride's Q2 FY27 investor deck estimates that 1.55 Mtpa of planned smelter capacity at NALCO, Hindalco and Vedanta, equal to 36% of India's current smelting base, could need 21,600-30,900 tpa of extra AlF3 at 14-20 kg/t (S37). Our own project-by-project sum is lower, about 18,300-26,200 tpa on about 1.31 Mtpa (S28)(S32)(S36).

Customer concentration is easing. Alufluoride's largest customer was 54% of FY26 AlF3 revenue, down from 69% in FY25. Its top two customers took 72% and Odisha 70%, and it is qualified at Hindalco, Vedanta and NALCO (S37)(S3).

Q2 FY27 recap (14 Nov): Alufluoride's revenue rose 17% to Rs 63.9 cr, EBITDA 70% to Rs 24.4 cr (36.1% margin) and PAT 91% to Rs 15.2 cr. Cheaper forward-bought inventory, which management expects to taper, drove much of the margin gain (S30)(S31). On 18 Nov it filed the record date for its Rs 2.50 interim dividend (S4).

NALCO: on 23 Nov it incorporated NLC NALCO Power, a 50:50 JV for the 1,080 MW captive plant feeding the Angul expansion (460 kt to about 1 Mtpa, Rs 30,000 cr, 2030-31) (S15)(S32). Its filings still say nothing on the AlF3 EoI, which closed 30 Oct (S15)(S21).

Paradeep: no AlF3 news. A summary of its Q1 call puts the plant at Rs 180-200 cr revenue and Rs 60 cr EBITDA, against 'at least Rs 50 cr' in the transcript we read (S38)(S1). On the Q2 call, management expected sulphur prices to soften within a month and said it plans to invest in non-subsidised 'valorization' projects (S38). Q2 phosphoric acid output was down 18.9% (S34).

China AlF3: the latest SMM quotes found are 12,800-13,200 yuan/t (5 Nov), with November tenders 'largely stable' (S33). SMM's month-end review expected prices to hold up in November on tight spot supply, low inventories and winter stockpiling by smelters (S39). We found no newer weekly review.

Trade: on 19 Nov India opened an anti-dumping probe into aluminium extrusions from China, Malaysia, Vietnam and Thailand, but it does not cover AlF3 or other smelter inputs (S40). We again found no DGTR action on AlF3.

Market: Alufluoride closed at Rs 652 on 23 Nov (-4.1% on the day, market cap Rs 510 cr, 52-week high Rs 716) (S4). Paradeep closed at Rs 141 (S14) and NALCO at Rs 299 (S15). We found no broker or media report grouping these names as an AlF3 theme.

for_investors.title: Who benefits
points: Alufluoride, the only listed pure-play: 24,000 tpa installed, all of its operating revenue from AlF3, and a 36.1% Q2 EBITDA margin (S30)(S37). Its own estimate of 21,600-30,900 tpa of new demand is close to its whole current capacity (S37).
Paradeep Phosphates would turn its 9,000-10,000 tpa of FSA into a non-subsidy product, guided at Rs 180-200 cr revenue (S1)(S38). That is under 1% of TTM sales of Rs 23,939 cr (S14).
Smelters (NALCO, Hindalco, VAML): more domestic supply cuts reliance on imports such as NALCO's Jan 2026 global tender, ahead of new capacity from FY28 to 2031 (S23)(S32)(S36).

for_investors.title: Who is hurt / risks
points: Alufluoride's Q2 margin was helped by low-cost inventory that management expects to taper, while FSA freight costs are rising (S30)(S31).
FSA depends on phosphoric acid run rates. Paradeep's Q2 acid output fell 18.9% (S34). Paradeep plans to use its own HFSA in-house (S1), and it is an 'as available' supplier to Alufluoride (S3).
Concentration is still high even after easing: Alufluoride's top two customers are 72% of AlF3 revenue (S37).

for_investors.title: What to watch
points: Any NALCO filing on the AlF3 EoI shortlist, RFP or JV. Its 23 Nov power JV filing shows Angul supply-chain JVs are moving (S15)(S23).
Paradeep's first engineering or ordering milestone on the 15,000 tpa AlF3 plant against its 22-24 month timeline (S1)(S38).
Alufluoride Q3 FY27: whether margins hold as cheap inventory runs off (S30), and China's December tender settlement (S39).

sections.title: What AlF3 is and how the fertiliser by-product route works

subsections.title: The product, demand driver and price reference

blocks.text: Aluminium fluoride is added to the cryolite bath in aluminium electrolysis to lower its melting point and improve conductivity (S10). Alufluoride says 14-20 kg of AlF3 is used per tonne of aluminium. It describes the Indian market as supplied by fewer than five domestic makers plus imports, with only a few able to supply the high-purity, low-bulk-density grade the major smelters need (S3)(S37). AlF3 demand therefore rises in line with primary aluminium output.

Official recent import volumes could not be confirmed, and Alufluoride's deck does not disclose current Indian demand or imports (S37). NALCO's turn to AlF3 supply security shows how much it relies on imports today (S23). Searches this week again found no DGTR or customs action on AlF3. The anti-dumping probe opened on 19 Nov covers aluminium extrusions only (S40).

blocks.text: SMM attributes the price strength to cost support from tight fluorite plus smelter restocking (S33)(S39). Firm Chinese prices reduce the near-term import threat to Indian producers, but because the support is cost-led it could reverse if fluorite eases. We found no SMM weekly review dated after 5 Nov.

subsections.title: The FSA route and its bottleneck

blocks.text: In the wet route, aluminium hydroxide is reacted with hydrofluosilicic acid (FSA/HFSA), the silica is filtered out, and the AlF3 is crystallised and dried (S10). FSA is a by-product of phosphoric acid at phosphate fertiliser plants, so AlF3 supply depends on fertiliser operating rates (S3).

items: Paradeep Phosphates makes about 9,000-10,000 tpa of FSA and sells all of it to outside buyers today (S1).

Alufluoride buys FSA from the adjacent fertiliser complex, IFFCO Paradeep and Coromandel Kakinada under long-term contracts, plus a supplier added in April 2026. Its FSA constraint, disclosed on 23 May, was reported resolved on 15 July (S31).

Upstream, Paradeep's Q2 FY27 phosphoric acid output fell 18.9% to 97,600 t on West Asia and Hormuz risks to sulphur and ammonia (S34). Management called sulphur availability 'unprecedented' (S35), but on the Q2 call it said it expected sulphur prices to soften within a month (S38).
Paradeep's phosphoric acid expansion (0.5 to 0.7 Mt) has phase 1 due in Q1 FY28 and phase 2 awaiting clearance for H2 FY29/FY30 (S38). More acid output would mean more FSA.

blocks.text: NALCO's EoI seeks either an equity JV, preferably near the Angul smelter, or a long-term partnership with assured offtake. Responses lead to a shortlist and then a detailed RFP or JV talks. Applicants need AlF3 manufacturing experience and access to feedstock (S23). The deadline was extended from 12 Oct to 30 Oct (S21). NALCO's November filings cover the power JV (23 Nov), a scandium-from-red-mud MoU with RUSAL (18 Nov) and the 4 Nov smelter update, but nothing on AlF3 (S15).

On paper, new supply (+6 kt at Alufluoride, +15 kt at Paradeep) roughly matches 18-31 kt of new demand. But both draw on FSA from the same few east-coast phosphoric acid plants (S1)(S31), and Paradeep's Q2 acid output fell 19% (S34). Feedstock, not plant capacity, is the binding limit.

blocks.caption: Alufluoride Q2 FY27 versus Q2 FY26 (Rs cr)

blocks.text: Alufluoride did not disclose Q2 tonnage (S31). Its largest customer fell to 54% of FY26 AlF3 revenue from 69% in FY25. Its top two customers took 72% and Odisha 70% (S37)(S3). Net worth was Rs 140.6 cr and cash and investments Rs 62.9 cr at 30 Sep (S30).

SPIC makes 'Greenstar' ALF-96 AlF3 by the FSA-alumina hydrate route. Its named customers are Hindalco, Dubal, Stella and Foundry Service (S10). It does not disclose AlF3 capacity or revenue, and its Sep-2026 quarter sales of Rs 999 cr were mostly fertiliser (S11). Tanfac lists AlF3 among its HF-derived products (S12). Its Rs 495 cr expansion is mainly a Rs 405 cr, 20,000 t HFC-32 plant (S13). Neither discloses AlF3 as a material earnings line.

Paradeep's Q2 FY27 PAT was about Rs 121 cr, down about 65%, on revenue of Rs 7,364 cr. Management guides H2 FY27 EBITDA of Rs 4,500-5,000 per tonne and total EBITDA of Rs 3,500 cr or more by 2029 (S35)(S38). The AlF3 plant's guidance differs by source: Rs 180-200 cr revenue with 'at least Rs 50 cr' EBITDA in the Q1 transcript (S1), and Rs 60 cr EBITDA in Sovrenn's call summary (S38). Either figure is under 1% of TTM sales of Rs 23,939 cr (S14). The Q2 call summaries give no AlF3 status update (S38)(S35).

Coromandel supplies FSA to Alufluoride from Kakinada (S31)(S3) and has announced no AlF3 plant. NALCO would seek an AlF3 JV for supply security rather than earnings (S23). Hindalco and VAML are buyers (S37)(S10) with no captive AlF3 plan found.

sections.title: Research house views and market positioning

items: We again found no broker or mainstream media report grouping these stocks as an 'AlF3 theme'. Alufluoride's Q2 was covered mainly by automated aggregators (S30)(S37), and trade press (SMM, AlCircle) covers the NALCO EoI and Chinese prices (S23)(S33).
Alufluoride closed at Rs 652 on 23 Nov, down 4.1% on the day, against Rs 658 on 16 Nov and a 52-week high of Rs 716 (S4). Some of the post-results gain has reversed.
Paradeep rose 14.54% intraday to Rs 159.50 on 29 Jul on the AlF3 approval (S2). It closed at Rs 141 on 23 Nov, against a 52-week range of Rs 99.7-170 (S14).
NALCO closed at Rs 299 on 23 Nov, against Rs 319 on 16 Nov and a 52-week range of Rs 250-445 (S15).

On Paradeep's Q1 call, analysts from Elara Securities, Aequitas, HDFC AMC and others asked about AlF3 timing, realisation and grade. Management said the plant targets Odisha smelters and needs no qualification period (S1). This is management's view.

blocks.caption: Valuation snapshot (screener.in via numbers.json, as of 23 Nov 2026 pre-market; Tanfac price fields unavailable)

items: Feedstock: the Q1 FSA shortage cut Alufluoride's quarterly sales to Rs 27 cr (S4), and Paradeep's Q2 phosphoric acid output was down 18.9% on sulphur constraints (S34)(S35).
Margin normalisation: Alufluoride's Q2 margin relied on cheaper inventory, a benefit management expects to taper, while FSA freight rises with fuel (S30)(S31).
Supplier turning competitor: Paradeep supplies FSA to Alufluoride 'as available' (S3) but plans to use its own HFSA (S1).
Entrant priorities: Paradeep is running a broader capex programme and calls subsidy-free 'valorization' projects a priority (S35)(S38). The AlF3 plant is under 1% of sales (S14).
Price: China's strength is cost-driven (S33)(S39). If fluorite eases, imports could get cheaper.
Concentration and timing: Alufluoride's top two customers are 72% of AlF3 revenue (S37). Most new smelter demand lands in FY28-2031 (S36)(S32).
Liquidity: Alufluoride's market cap is about Rs 510 cr (S4).

companies.name: Alufluoride Ltd
companies.role: Converts fertiliser FSA into AlF3 at Visakhapatnam, with 24,000 tpa installed (S3)(S37). It is qualified at Hindalco, Vedanta and NALCO (S37).
companies.impact: The most direct play on the theme. Q2 FY27 revenue rose 17% to Rs 63.9 cr and PAT 91% to Rs 15.2 cr after FSA supply resumed (S30). It estimates 21,600-30,900 tpa of new demand from planned smelters, and its largest customer has fallen to 54% of revenue (S37). Management flags a tapering inventory benefit and rising freight (S31).

companies.name: Southern Petrochemicals Industries Corporation (SPIC)
companies.role: Makes Greenstar ALF-96 AlF3 by the FSA route for Hindalco, Dubal and others (S10). Mainly a urea maker (S11).
companies.impact: AlF3 capacity and revenue are undisclosed. Against Sep-quarter sales of Rs 999 cr (S11), AlF3 is unlikely to be a meaningful earnings driver on current evidence.

companies.name: Tanfac Industries Ltd
companies.role: HF-based fluorochemicals maker whose products include aluminium fluoride (S12).
companies.impact: Growth comes from HF and a Rs 405 cr HFC-32 plant (S13), not AlF3. The AlF3 theme is marginal for the stock.

companies.name: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd
companies.role: DAP/NPK maker producing 9,000-10,000 tpa of FSA. It is building a Rs 250 cr, 15,000 tpa AlF3 plant (S1)(S2).
companies.impact: AlF3 is guided at Rs 180-200 cr revenue and Rs 50-60 cr EBITDA, depending on source (S1)(S38), under 1% of sales (S14). Q2 phosphoric acid output fell 18.9% (S34), and there has been no AlF3 progress update since July (S38).

companies.name: Coromandel International Ltd
companies.role: Supplies FSA to Alufluoride from its Kakinada phosphoric acid plant (S3)(S31).
companies.impact: An FSA supplier only, with no AlF3 plant announced. AlF3 would be immaterial for a company with a market cap of about Rs 58,900 cr (numbers.json).

companies.name: National Aluminium Company Ltd (NALCO)
companies.role: Expanding the Angul smelter from 460 kt to about 1 Mtpa for Rs 30,000 cr by 2030-31 (S32). Sought AlF3 JV or partner proposals through an EoI that closed 30 Oct 2026 (S21)(S23).
companies.impact: The aim is supply security, not earnings. It incorporated the NLC NALCO Power JV on 23 Nov, but no AlF3 EoI outcome has been filed (S15).

companies.name: Hindalco Industries Ltd
companies.role: Buys AlF3 from Alufluoride and SPIC (S37)(S10). Expanding Aditya by 181 kt (FY28) and 193 kt (FY29) (S36).
companies.impact: Implies about 5-7.5 kt/yr of extra AlF3 demand from FY28-29 (our arithmetic on S3 and S36). No captive AlF3 plan found.

companies.name: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Ltd (VAML)
companies.role: Vedanta's demerged and separately listed aluminium business (S29). An AlF3 customer of Alufluoride (S37), it is ramping the BALCO 435 kt expansion (S28).
companies.impact: The nearest-term demand addition: Vedanta's additions are expected by FY28 (S37), and it reported record Q2 FY27 aluminium output of 649 kt (S28). No captive AlF3 plan found.

companies.name: Vedanta Ltd
companies.role: Former parent of the aluminium business. Its shareholders received VAML shares 1:1 (S29).
companies.impact: After the demerger, AlF3 demand sits with VAML (S29). Kept for continuity only.

method: Weekly refresh of the 2026-W47 edition, researched on 24 Nov 2026 using web search and direct page fetches. Re-fetched the screener pages for Alufluoride, Paradeep and NALCO for 23 Nov closing prices and announcement lists (S4)(S14)(S15). New this week: (1) Alufluoride's Q2 deck, via a Multibagg summary (S37): its 21,600-30,900 tpa demand estimate and the FY26 drop in customer concentration (largest customer 54%, from 69%). (2) Alufluoride's 18 Nov dividend record-date filing (S4). (3) NALCO's 23 Nov incorporation of NLC NALCO Power and its 18 Nov RUSAL scandium MoU (S15). Neither concerns AlF3, and the AlF3 EoI outcome is still unfiled. (4) Sovrenn's Paradeep call summary (S38), which gives Rs 60 cr AlF3 EBITDA against 'at least Rs 50 cr' in the Q1 transcript (S1); both are shown. (5) SMM's month-end October review, via AlCircle (S39). Searches found no SMM weekly review dated after 5 Nov (S33). (6) The 19 Nov anti-dumping probe on aluminium extrusions (S40), which does not cover AlF3. Dropped: the Hindalco Jan 2026 filing (S6, superseded by the S36 phasing), the 22 Oct SMM review (S22, superseded by S39 and S33), the BALCO output item (former S20) and the Free Press Journal Paradeep item (S26; Q2 figures are kept via S35). Source IDs are kept from earlier editions, so there are gaps in the numbering. The SPIC and Tanfac screener pages were not re-fetched this week (still dated 17 Nov). The valuation table uses numbers.json (screener.in, 23 Nov 2026 pre-market), which has no price data for Tanfac. Market-cap coverage: small caps (Alufluoride, SPIC), mid caps (Tanfac, Paradeep) and large caps (Coromandel, NALCO, Hindalco, VAML). A search for new Indian AlF3 entrants this week found only Paradeep and Alufluoride. Earlier searches for AlF3 plans at FACT, GSFC, Gujarat Fluorochemicals and Navin Fluorine found nothing qualifying, so the listed pure-play universe is still effectively one small cap. Not verified: NALCO EoI respondents, AlF3 revenue at SPIC and Tanfac, India's import volumes, Alufluoride Q2 tonnage. Per-project demand figures are our own arithmetic. No ratings or price targets.
